facts.text: Appeal item: OSSC 1407.10.4 requires NFPA 285 testing of the metal composite material panel system intended for use; the request substitutes metal composite panels for metal panels at exterior soffit assemblies 3C.1 and 3C.7.
The applicant cites an equivalency letter prepared by an engineering firm and says the alternate product matches the design-review mirrored finish of the soffit.
Decision: use of metal composite panels in lieu of metal panel at exterior soffits is granted as proposed.
